title: Review of the commits of one key and one pass of the fix mode
description: Content of fix/<repo>/<slug>/review-<N>.json, written by the read-only reviewer and checked by cqa_fix.py validate <run_dir> <key> review --pass <N> (exit 6 with the list of errors). Every row the fixer reported fixed in pass N needs a verdict. A blocking verdict sends the row back to the fixer for one more attempt; still blocking after it, the row is dropped from the branch. Notes and remarks are written in French.

pass.description: Number of the pass whose commits were reviewed.

rows.description: One verdict per reviewed row. A ref that is not a row of the key, or that appears twice, is rejected.

attention.description: Non-blocking remarks for the Points d'attention section of the merge request, in French. [] when there are none.

ref.description: Ref of the checklist row, as an integer (107 for CQ-107).

verdict.description: ok: the fix may go in the merge request. blocking: it may not as is; say why in notes.

notes.description: Required for blocking: what is wrong and what to change, in French, 1 to 600 characters. Optional for ok.

rows.notes: La valeur n'est pas échappée à l'affichage : utiliser esc_html().

attention: La règle d'en-tête s'applique aussi aux fichiers statiques : vérifier le cache du CDN.
